parameters.help_en: The ID of the Service Mesh instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

parameters.help_en: The list of services associated with the swim lane group
parameters.help_zh: 泳道组关联的服务列表
parameters.name: services_list

parameters.help_en: The name of the swim lane group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the baseline swim lane for the group. This parameter is used only if the group operates in loose mode
parameters.help_zh: 宽松模式泳道组的基线泳道名称。仅在泳道组为宽松模式时，设置此参数有效
parameters.name: fallback_target

parameters.help_en:
The policy for routing requests to the swim lanes in the group. Valid values:

`weighted`: Specifies a weight-based routing policy. Requests that match a single, group-wide routing rule are routed to different swim lanes based on specified weights.

`rule-based`: Specifies a rule-based routing policy. Each swim lane has its own routing rule. A request is forwarded to a swim lane only if it matches that swim lane's routing rule
parameters.help_zh:
为泳道组内的多个泳道进行请求引流的策略，有两种可能取值：
weighted：基于权重的引流策略，即首先以统一的规则对请求进行匹配，对匹配到的请求进行引流，引流时，按照给定的比例将所有请求发往不同的泳道。
rule-based：基于规则的引流策略，即泳道组中的每条泳道都拥有自己的匹配规则，只有匹配到泳道对应的引流规则的请求才会被转发到对应的泳道
parameters.name: ingress_routing_strategy

parameters.help_en: The routing rule for the entire swim lane group. This parameter is used when the group's routing policy is `weighted`
parameters.help_zh: 当泳道组的引流策略为weighted时可以设定。作用于整个泳道组的引流规则，
parameters.name: weighted_ingress_rule

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not in use
parameters.name: service_level_fallback_target
